label: Consolidation breakout v1.1 — target from risk (Candidate B)
status: research assumption; swing mode only (intraday closed by the owner); not a proven edge. Development and validation are in-sample for this version.

stop.interpretation: below the breakout candle's low (its lower wick) minus an ATR buffer; the source video's wick-based stop is ambiguous and this is the chosen reading

target.notes: Target = effective entry + entry.minRewardRisk x (effective entry - stop), set at the simulated fill from the actual fill price and rounded up to the tick. Replaces cb-1.0.0 target = ceiling + 1 x box height (PARAMETER-LOG.md, 2026-10-22).

costs.notes: Market and stop fills pay half the spread plus slippage; limit fills (target, entry at or below the limit) pay neither. Commission applies to every fill. Currency conversion applies only when the account currency differs from the instrument currency.

risk.notes: Testing assumptions only. They are not the owner's approved live risk limits. Gaps can make a loss larger than the planned risk.
